hypotheses.name: Community co-membership enriches immune regulatory edges
hypotheses.method: Built kNN graph communities on immune scGPT residual embeddings (3 seeds x 12 layers x source/target-disjoint splits) and tested same-community edge membership against labels with 300 label permutations per row.
hypotheses.result_value: source AUC 0.5387, target AUC 0.5413; 12/12 layers AUC>0.5 and Fisher-significant in both splits
hypotheses.next_action: Test whether within-community enrichment scales with DoRothEA/STRING confidence tiers.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model geometric feature transfer on shared metrics
hypotheses.method: Compared scGPT and Geneformer delta-AUROC rankings for shared geometric features (centered_cosine/dot/cosine) across immune, lung, and external_lung with exact feature-index permutation nulls (6 per domain, 216 global).
hypotheses.result_value: mean rho 0.8333; top feature match 3/3 domains; exact global p(mean rho)=0.0369, p(top-match-count)=0.0415
hypotheses.next_action: Expand to a larger matched feature panel and per-edge transfer tests to de-risk small-feature-set effects.

hypotheses.name: Intrinsic dimensionality coupling with geodesic advantage
hypotheses.method: Computed participation-ratio and local-linearity metrics for immune scGPT seed-layer-split embeddings, merged with iter_0010 geodesic-minus-Euclidean AUROC deltas, and tested seed-mean Spearman coupling via 3000 within-seed layer permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: source split weak (|rho|=0.235, p~0.17); target split stronger (linearity rho=+0.408 p=0.014, participation rho=-0.408 p=0.019)
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate the same coupling test in lung/external_lung to determine if target-disjoint coupling generalizes.
